title: SOFI_Inception_Butterfly_Epistemic_Physical_Diffusion_Audit_Protocol
description: Unified canonical protocol for auditing contextual information propagation, attribution, evidence, causality, perturbation, physical signal detection, temporal synchronization, provenance, falsification, and empirical validation.

01_scope.purpose: Provide a falsifiable, evidence-gated framework for determining whether defined information states, human cognitive states, environmental states, and persistent artifacts participate in a measurable causal information-transfer process.

02_core_model.important_constraint: A represented relationship is not automatically a demonstrated physical causal relationship.

03_sofi_inception_model.name: SOFI_Inception_Butterfly_Effect
03_sofi_inception_model.inception_principle: A subsequent state may depend informationally on a prior contextual state while remaining a distinct observable artifact.

04_butterfly_effect.definition: A controlled perturbation of an initial state may produce a measurable downstream divergence in a sufficiently sensitive system.
04_butterfly_effect.success_condition: Observed downstream divergence exceeds the preregistered noise envelope and is specifically attributable to the controlled perturbation after confound analysis.

06_signal_framework.objective: Detect and characterize candidate physical information-bearing signals without presupposing their carrier or mechanism.

primary_brain_modality.name: EEG
primary_brain_modality.purpose: high-temporal-resolution measurement of brain electrical activity

physiological_control.name: ECG
physiological_control.purpose: independent physiological reference and arousal control

acoustic.name: acoustic_vibration
acoustic.purpose: measurement of acoustic and mechanical environmental confounds

digital_provenance.name: timestamped_digital_information_channel
digital_provenance.purpose: exact recording of CORE state, perturbation, artifact, and experimental events

07_timing_and_synchronization.objective: Maintain auditable temporal alignment among digital, physiological, environmental, and physical measurement streams.

hardware_alignment.purpose: Independently measure acquisition-path timing differences across recording systems.

08_perturbation_protocol.objective: Define a controlled minimal alteration to CORE sufficient to test causal transmission while minimizing physiological, sensory, electromagnetic, mechanical, acoustic, and procedural confounds.

information_difference.definition: Predefined difference between matched CORE states.

modality_isolation.requirement: No intentional change to non-target modalities.

baseline_matching.requirement: States A and B must satisfy preregistered equivalence criteria before t_perturbation.

sham.purpose: Measure effects caused by procedure, expectation, timing, or instrumentation rather than Delta_CORE.

null.purpose: Measure spontaneous trajectory variation without perturbation.

positive_control.purpose: Verify that the measurement system can detect a known perturbation.

10_divergence_analysis.specificity_requirement: Downstream change must discriminate Delta_CORE from sham, null, and measured confounding conditions.

temporal_precedence.requirement: Divergence must follow t_perturbation after accounting for measured acquisition latency and clock uncertainty.

counterfactual_requirement.statement: A matched sham condition must not produce the same specified effect.

directionality.requirement: Manipulation of CORE must precede and predict the measured downstream response.

dose_response.purpose: Determine whether systematic variation in perturbation magnitude produces a preregistered corresponding response.

reversal_test.purpose: Determine whether removal or reversal of Delta_CORE produces the corresponding preregistered change.

H1.statement: A measurable physical signal carries information between defined system states, including CORE and BRAIN, producing reproducible downstream effects beyond independently modeled background processes.

H0.statement: Observed relationships can be explained without a previously unmeasured common physical diffusion signal.

reject_causal_interpretation_if: The effect disappears after acquisition latency correction.
The effect is explained by measured physiological, electromagnetic, acoustic, mechanical, sensory, procedural, or statistical confounds.
reject_novel_physical_mechanism_if: No reproducible physical signal is detected.
The candidate signal contains no demonstrable information about the manipulated state.
Known physical pathways adequately explain the observation.

allowed_only_when: Known confounds tested and insufficient to explain the effect.
Raw data and analysis provenance are independently auditable.

17_information_space_claim.proposition: All represented spaces may participate in a common information process involving CORE and BRAIN.
17_information_space_claim.strong_physical_version: A single physical diffusion signal connects the represented spaces and carries information involving CORE and BRAIN.
17_information_space_claim.classification_rule: The strong physical version cannot be classified as an established physical fact until the establishment threshold is satisfied.
